source_refs.note: Exercise 10.3, Question 1: book page 194 (PDF 199); answer key PDF 308 gives values for other data (both parts), boxed; checked with sympy and the solution book (PDF 933-936).

blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find the values of \(\sin 2\alpha\), \(\cos 2\alpha\) and \(\tan 2\alpha\), when: \(\sin\alpha = \frac{84}{85}\)
blocks.explanation:
Humein \(\sin\alpha\) diya hai aur double angle \(2\alpha\) ke teen ratios chahiye.
Diya kya hai? \(\sin\alpha = \frac{84}{85}\). Find kya karna hai? \(\sin 2\alpha\), \(\cos 2\alpha\), \(\tan 2\alpha\).
Rule kaunsa? Double angle formulas, jin mein \(\sin\alpha\) aur \(\cos\alpha\) dono chahiye hote hain.
Plan: pehle \(\cos\alpha\) nikalna, phir formulas mein rakhna, aur aakhir mein divide kar ke \(\tan 2\alpha\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sin\alpha = \frac{84}{85}\). Part (i) ke saath quadrant nahi likha; part (ii) ke saath likhi shart \(0 < \alpha < \frac{\pi}{2}\) hum dono parts par lagate hain, yani \(\alpha\) acute hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(\sin 2\alpha\), \(\cos 2\alpha\), \(\tan 2\alpha\).
Tareeqa: \(\sin^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha = 1\) se \(\cos\alpha\) nikalenge, phir Section 10.4 ke double angle formulas lagayenge. Quadrant is liye zaroori hai ke square root lete waqt \(+\) ya \(-\) ka faisla wahi karta hai.

\(\cos\alpha\) nikalein
\[\cos^2\alpha = 1 - \left(\dfrac{84}{85}\right)^2\]
\[= \dfrac{7225 - 7056}{7225} = \dfrac{169}{7225}\]
\[\cos\alpha = \dfrac{13}{85}\]
Kyun: \(85^2 = 7225\) aur \(84^2 = 7056\). 1 ko \(\frac{7225}{7225}\) likh kar minus kiya. \(\sqrt{169} = 13\) aur \(\sqrt{7225} = 85\). \(\alpha\) quadrant I mein hai, is liye positive root liya.

\(\sin 2\alpha\) nikalein
\[\sin 2\alpha = 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\]
\[= 2 \cdot \dfrac{84}{85} \cdot \dfrac{13}{85}\]
\[= \dfrac{2184}{7225}\]
Kyun: Yeh sine ka double angle formula hai, jo \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\) mein \(\beta = \alpha\) rakhne se banta hai. Upar \(2 \times 84 \times 13 = 2184\), neeche \(85 \times 85 = 7225\).

\(\cos 2\alpha\) nikalein
\[\cos 2\alpha = 1 - 2\sin^2\alpha\]
\[= 1 - \dfrac{2(7056)}{7225}\]
\[= \dfrac{7225 - 14112}{7225}\]
\[= -\dfrac{6887}{7225}\]
Kyun: \(\cos 2\alpha\) ki teen shakalein hain; humne woh chuni jis mein sirf \(\sin\alpha\) aata hai, kyunke woh sawal mein seedha diya hua hai. Is tarah ghalti ka chance kam.
Dhyan dein: jawab negative aana ghalti nahi; aage tasdeeq mein wajah dekhenge.

\(\tan 2\alpha\) nikalein
\[\tan 2\alpha = \dfrac{\sin 2\alpha}{\cos 2\alpha}\]
\[= \dfrac{2184/7225}{-6887/7225}\]
\[= -\dfrac{2184}{6887}\]
Kyun: Tan, sin ko cos se divide karne se milta hai. Dono ka denominator 7225 ek jaisa hai, is liye cancel ho gaya aur sirf upar wale numbers bache.

Tasdeeq
\[2184^2 + 6887^2 = 52\,200\,625\]
\[7225^2 = 52\,200\,625 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Har angle ke liye \(\sin^2 + \cos^2 = 1\) hona chahiye, yani numerators ke squares ka jama denominator ke square ke barabar. Yeh poora hua. Sign bhi theek hai: \(\sin\alpha > \cos\alpha\) hai, is liye \(\alpha > 45^{\circ}\), aur \(2\alpha > 90^{\circ}\) quadrant II mein jahan cos negative hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(\sin 2\alpha = \frac{120}{169}\), \(\cos 2\alpha = -\frac{119}{169}\), \(\tan 2\alpha = -\frac{120}{119}\) likha hai. Yeh jawab \(\sin\alpha = \frac{12}{13}\) ke hain, kitab mein chhape \(\sin\alpha = \frac{84}{85}\) ke nahi. Sahi jawab \(\frac{2184}{7225}\), \(-\frac{6887}{7225}\), \(-\frac{2184}{6887}\) hain. Sabaq: answer key ko hamesha sawal ke diye hue data se mila kar dekhein.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find the values of \(\sin 2\alpha\), \(\cos 2\alpha\) and \(\tan 2\alpha\), when: \(\cos\alpha = \frac{120}{169}\), where \(0 < \alpha < \frac{\pi}{2}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh part (i) jaisa hi hai, farq yeh ke is dafa \(\cos\alpha\) diya hai aur quadrant bhi saaf likha hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\cos\alpha = \frac{120}{169}\), \(\alpha\) quadrant I mein. Find kya karna hai? \(\sin 2\alpha\), \(\cos 2\alpha\), \(\tan 2\alpha\).
Plan: \(\sin\alpha\) nikalna, phir double angle formulas, phir divide.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\cos\alpha = \frac{120}{169}\), \(0 < \alpha < \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\sin 2\alpha\), \(\cos 2\alpha\), \(\tan 2\alpha\).
Tareeqa: \(\sin^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha = 1\) se \(\sin\alpha\), phir \(\sin 2\alpha = 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha\) aur \(\cos 2\alpha = 2\cos^2\alpha - 1\). Is dafa cos wali shakal chuni kyunke cos diya hua hai.

\(\sin\alpha\) nikalein
\[\sin^2\alpha = 1 - \left(\dfrac{120}{169}\right)^2\]
\[= \dfrac{28561 - 14400}{28561} = \dfrac{14161}{28561}\]
\[\sin\alpha = \dfrac{119}{169}\]
Kyun: \(169^2 = 28561\), \(120^2 = 14400\), aur \(14161 = 119^2\). Quadrant I mein sin positive, is liye plus wala root.
Dhyan dein: 119, 120, 169 ek Pythagorean triple hai (\(119^2 + 120^2 = 169^2\)); aise numbers dekh kar aap seedha andaza laga sakte hain.

\(\sin 2\alpha\) nikalein
\[\sin 2\alpha = 2 \cdot \dfrac{119}{169} \cdot \dfrac{120}{169}\]
\[= \dfrac{28560}{28561}\]
Kyun: Double angle formula. \(2 \times 119 \times 120 = 28560\) aur \(169^2 = 28561\). Value 1 ke bohat qareeb hai, yani \(2\alpha\) taqreeban \(90^{\circ}\) hai.

\(\cos 2\alpha\) nikalein
\[\cos 2\alpha = 2\cos^2\alpha - 1\]
\[= \dfrac{2(14400)}{28561} - 1\]
\[= \dfrac{28800 - 28561}{28561} = \dfrac{239}{28561}\]
Kyun: \(2 \times 14400 = 28800\), aur 1 ko \(\frac{28561}{28561}\) likh kar minus kiya. Chhota sa positive number aaya, jo is baat se milta hai ke \(2\alpha\) \(90^{\circ}\) se thora sa kam hai.

\(\tan 2\alpha\) nikalein
\[\tan 2\alpha = \dfrac{28560}{239}\]
Kyun: \(\sin 2\alpha\) ko \(\cos 2\alpha\) se divide kiya; denominator 28561 dono mein tha, cancel ho gaya. Bara jawab aana theek hai, kyunke \(90^{\circ}\) ke qareeb tan bohat bara hota hai.

Tasdeeq
\[28561^2 - 28560^2 = 28561 + 28560\]
\[= 57121 = 239^2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\sin^2 2\alpha + \cos^2 2\alpha = 1\) ka matlab hai \(28560^2 + 239^2 = 28561^2\). Bare squares ki bajaye difference of squares \((a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b))\) lagaya: \(a - b = 1\), is liye sirf \(a + b = 57121\) bacha, jo \(239^2\) hai. Jawab sahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(\sin 2\alpha = \frac{24}{25}\), \(\cos 2\alpha = -\frac{7}{25}\), \(\tan 2\alpha = -\frac{24}{7}\) likha hai. Yeh \(\cos\alpha = \frac{3}{5}\) ke jawab hain, chhape hue \(\cos\alpha = \frac{120}{169}\) ke nahi. Sahi jawab \(\frac{28560}{28561}\), \(\frac{239}{28561}\), \(\frac{28560}{239}\) hain. Sabaq: answer key ko hamesha sawal ke diye hue data se mila kar dekhein.
